description: This file defines the implementation of a PDCCH modulator class for 5G NR physical layer processing, including resource block calculations, scrambling, modulation, and mapping functions.

classes.name: pdcch_modulator_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the PDCCH modulator handling scrambling, modulation, and resource mapping for 5G NR.

methods.name: scramble
methods.description: Scrambles input bits according to 3GPP TS38.211 Section 7.3.2.3.

methods.name: modulate
methods.description: Performs modulation of scrambled bits into complex symbols following 3GPP TS38.211 Section 7.3.2.4.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps modulated symbols onto resource grid as per 3GPP TS38.211 Section 7.3.2.5.

methods.name: modulate
methods.description: Public interface to modulate data into resource grid.
